name: Philly Cheesesteak Stuffed Peppers
note: Shaved-steak + provolone + onion/mushroom baked in a bell-pepper vessel, no starch base - 535 cal / 9g carbs, center-of-band and structurally low-carb. Cross-lane dedup against fresh accepted-slugs (9) and catalog digest: catalog carries philly-cheesesteak-skillet-bowls (ground beef + rice), but this differs on 3 of 4 axes - protein (shaved steak vs ground), starch (pepper vessel/none vs rice), method (baked stuffed vs skillet). Only the philly flavor family overlaps, so not a near-duplicate. No stuffed-pepper cheesesteak in the catalog or accepted list. Distinct from the beef stuffed-pepper family generally. Cross-protein watch (unresolved, for orchestrator): a chicken/turkey/pork 'philly cheesesteak stuffed peppers' would be the same construction protein-swapped.
